texts.value: In response to DNA damage, associates with TP53/p53 to prevent MDM2-mediated degradation of TP53 and promote TP53-mediated signaling (PubMed:19616514, PubMed:22914926, PubMed:28051100). Also protects KAT5/TIP60 from degradation, which further promotes TP53/p53-mediated signaling (PubMed:19308289)

Interacts (via N-terminus) with PPEF1; the interaction is direct, and leads to dephosphorylation of PDCD5 at Ser-119, PDCD5 destabilization, and downstream inhibition of TP53/p53-mediated signaling (PubMed:28051100). Interacts with TP53; the interaction is direct and prevents the interaction between TP53 and MDM2, thereby stabilizing TP53 (PubMed:22914926). Interacts with KAT5/TIP60; the interaction is direct and leads to stabilization of the KAT5 protein (PubMed:19308289)
Accumulates in the nucleus in response to genotoxic stress
Widely expressed. Highest levels in heart, testis, kidney, pituitary gland, adrenal gland and placenta
Expression in fetal tissues is significantly lower than in adult tissues
Induced in response to DNA damage (at protein level)
Phosphorylated at Ser-119 by casein kinase II (PubMed:19616514, PubMed:28051100). Dephosphorylated at Ser-119 by PPEF1, which promotes its degradation by the proteasome (PubMed:28051100)
